text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-021 without referencing it","detail":"EXP-021 already tested a peak-hour surge incentive and found that adjacent zones lost drivers and that zone-level A/B overstated the lift. The proposal neither references nor learns from this result.","evidence_quote":"Launch a surge incentive during peak hours across all markets and watch the dashboard.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-021-peak-surge-incentive"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-021, explain what differs, and apply its learning by using a market or switchback design with neighbor tracking."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Required driver pay guardrails absent","detail":"A surge incentive is a pay lever and requires the guardrails Driver Hourly Earnings, Driver Safety Incident Rate, and Cost Per Delivery. The proposal lists none of them; its only guardrail is neighboring-zone acceptance.","evidence_quote":"Driver Acceptance Rate in neighboring zones: should not drop.","citations":["guardrail-standards#driver-pay-and-incentives"],"recommendation":"Add Driver Hourly Earnings, Driver Safety Incident Rate, and Cost Per Delivery as guardrails with explicit stop thresholds."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"No experiment plan; full rollout with dashboard monitoring","detail":"The proposal has no randomization, control group, duration, MDE, or power, and rolls out to all markets. EXP-021 showed that naive designs are biased by interference and recommended market or switchback designs.","evidence_quote":"None. We will roll out to all markets and monitor the dashboard.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-021-peak-surge-incentive","experimentation-standards#guardrail-breach-policy"],"recommendation":"Design a market-level or switchback experiment of at least 14 days with an MDE, a power calculation, and guardrail stop thresholds, and phase the rollout."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Driver pay change without recorded review","detail":"The incentive changes driver pay, a policy-controlled area, and the Reviews section says None. No pay or policy review is recorded.","evidence_quote":"None.","citations":["guardrail-standards#driver-pay-and-incentives"],"recommendation":"Record the required driver pay and incentives review and approval before launch."}]}
